Anketa.basic_headline: Tell us a little about yourself.
Anketa.basic_lead: The basics: your name, age, where you live. Your name will be visible in your profile; after publishing, changing your name may require re-verification.
Anketa.birthplace_lead: Your home region is about cultural and family context. No exact address needed.
Anketa.self_eyebrow: Profile · About you and what you do
Anketa.self_lead: Tell us about yourself, your education and what you do now. This helps others better understand your lifestyle, values and how serious your intentions are.
Anketa.appearance_lead: These fields help us find people who understand you without translation and live at a similar pace.
Anketa.family_lead: These questions help us account for important expectations about family, children and the future. Your answers are used for more suitable recommendations.
Anketa.values_lead: These questions help us understand which values and spiritual guideposts matter to you. There are no "right" answers here — what matters is an honest alignment of views.
Anketa.family_model_headline: How do you picture your future family?
Anketa.family_model_lead: These questions help us understand how you see roles, decisions and everyday life in a family. There are no right answers here — what matters is an alignment of views.
Anketa.marriage_headline: How do you picture life after marriage?
Anketa.marriage_lead: These questions help us understand your expectations about where you'll live, timelines for marriage and readiness to relocate. Some answers can be changed later.
Anketa.partner_extended_headline: Who do you want to meet?
Anketa.partner_extended_lead: Share the expectations that matter to you for a future partner. We'll consider not only formal details, but also values, views on family and life goals.

Anketa.photos_lead: Add photos that help others see you naturally and respectfully. Your first photo will be the main one. Documents and verification selfies are not shown to other users.
Anketa.preview_headline: This is how others will see your profile.

Main.paused_body: You're hidden from matching and won't receive new interests. Existing chats stay — you can still reply. Lift the pause whenever you're ready to continue.
Main.review_body: We're double-checking some details of your profile. While the review is in progress you're hidden from matching — this usually takes from a few hours to a day. As soon as everything is confirmed, matching turns on automatically.
Main.error_body: A temporary technical hiccup on our side. Refresh the page in a minute — your data is safe.
Main.empty_title: The algorithm is looking for the right person.
Main.empty_body: There's no profile yet that matches yours closely enough. That's normal — we don't show just anyone. New people appear every day: as soon as we find the right person, they'll be here.
Main.empty_body_2: In the meantime, you can widen your preferred age range in the profile or complete your psycho-portrait. The more precise your data, the broader and more accurate the matching.
Main.maint_body: We've temporarily paused new matches while we do some upkeep. Nothing is lost — check back a little later and today's match will be here.

Verify.headline: Let's confirm it's really you.
Verify.intro_description: On Baxtlilar, profiles go through identity verification. This helps reduce the risk of fake profiles and makes communication safer.
Verify.step_1_body: Upload an identity document. We'll show you which page or side of the document is needed.
Verify.step_2_body: We'll compare the selfie with the photo in your document to make sure it's really you creating the profile.
Verify.step_3_body: Verification usually takes anywhere from a few minutes to 24 hours. While it's in progress, you can continue filling out your profile.
Verify.privacy_footer: Documents and selfies don't appear in your profile and aren't visible to other users. Only authorized specialists and verification systems have access to them. Access is logged.
Verify.page_description: Photograph the page or side of the document showing your photo and main details. Don't upload pages with your address, registration, or extra data unless we ask for them.
Verify.upload_label: Take a photo or choose a file
Verify.req_focus: Sharp focus — the text is readable
Verify.req_glare: No glare or shadow across it
Verify.req_no_editing: No editing — no filters, frames, or overlays
Verify.title: Selfie for verification.
Verify.description: Take a selfie of your face in good lighting. We'll compare the selfie with the photo in the document you uploaded in the previous step.
Verify.footer_note: Once uploaded, your request goes for review. While it's in progress, you can continue filling out your profile. The decision will come via Telegram.
Verify.req_1: Face clearly visible: no mask or dark glasses. A religious head covering (headscarf, skullcap) is fine, as long as the face is uncovered.
Verify.req_2: Even lighting, no harsh shadows or glare.
Verify.req_4: Don't upload photos of other people — this may lead to account restrictions under the platform's rules

intro.title: Getting started · 1 of 4
intro.heading: How Baxtlilar works.
intro.body1: Baxtlilar shows you not an endless feed, but curated profiles matched to your values, goals, and family expectations.
intro.body2: In the MVP we show a limited number of profiles per day — so that meeting someone is intentional, not random.

swipe.title: Interest · 2 of 4
swipe.heading: No swipes.
swipe.body1: First you read the profile, then you decide — send interest or skip.
swipe.body2: You can add a short personal message to your interest. The other person will see it right away.
swipe.body3: If the interest is mutual — a chat opens.

chat.title: Chats · 3 of 4
chat.heading: Only after mutual interest.
chat.body1: A chat opens when both people have sent interest.
chat.body2: No mass messaging, spam, or pressure. Just a real conversation.
chat.body3: You can end the conversation at any time.

safety.title: Safety · 4 of 4
safety.heading: A few safety rules.
safety.body1: Don't share your phone, Telegram, external links, or personal details until you're ready for safe communication.
safety.body2: If someone behaves disrespectfully — tap "Report." A moderator will review the situation.
safety.body3: You can delete your profile in settings. Your public profile and photos will be removed from recommendations.
